01Accepting these terms

By visiting rentalrevive.com, submitting a form, or requesting the free audit, you agree to these Terms of Use and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the site. If you are using the site for a company, you confirm you are authorized to accept these terms on its behalf.

02Who can use the site

This site and the audit are meant for businesses and the people who run them. You must be at least 18 years old and able to enter into a contract. The audit is intended for independent equipment rental companies.

03What we offer here

This website describes what RentalRevive does and lets you request a free audit and get in touch. The site itself does not sign you up for any paid service. Any paid engagement, including the 30-Day Rental Rescue, 30-Day Quote Recovery Pilot, or Rental Revenue Desk, begins only under a separate written agreement that sets the actual scope, pricing, and terms.

04The free audit

The Missed Rental Audit + Dead-Quote Autopsy is provided free and for information only. When you request it, you agree that:

  • You will give accurate information, and you have the right to share the phone number, website, and business details you submit.
  • The audit is an estimate based on the information available to us and reasonable assumptions. It is not a guarantee of results, revenue, or performance.
  • Requesting the audit does not create a paid engagement or any obligation on either side.

05Illustrative figures

Numbers, examples, dollar amounts, and charts on this site and in the audit are illustrative unless clearly stated otherwise. They show how the math tends to work, not a promise of what your business will earn. Actual results depend on your market, your team, your pricing, and many factors outside our control.
